## Analysis

I identified the position and found that Black has a winning move: **Ba3+**, which forks (double-attacks) both the king on b2 and the rook on c1 along the a3-b2-c1 diagonal. After the king moves (forced, due to check), Black captures the undefended rook with Bxc1, winning material decisively.
